_note: stack_blocks r0C_demo (privileged_demo_assisted). Values under 'demo' and 'fallback_site' are offline statistics of the public scripted demos (HF RoboDojo-Benchmark/RoboDojo rev 35efbc7d, episodes 2900-2999, demos/analysis/summary_stdout.txt); they are plain numbers here, demo files are never read at runtime. Provenance per value in NOTES.md. Native action limit is not set here.

blocks._window_note: probe1: parked fingers are >=13.9 cm above the table in the head view, robot bases/mount behind y=-0.35; first survey window 7.5 cm (one block ~3.5 cm), later 3h+1 cm capped at 13.2 cm

demo._closing_axis_src: demo grasp EE quaternion (w,x,y,z)=(0.5,-0.5,0.5,0.5) in every grasp: approach -z, jaw closing axis (EE y) = world -x; yaw constant
demo._pregrasp_src: demo pre-grasp 6-14 cm above grasp point, median 8.8 cm
demo._grasp_src: demo grasp TCP 2.5 cm above table (p10 2.0, p90 2.8); release-minus-grasp per layer ~3.3 cm => block ~3.3 cm tall => grasp ~0.8 cm below top. Applied to the MEASURED top here.
demo._close_src: demo closes for 8 frames before lifting
demo._open_src: demo opens in 1 frame and immediately moves up; 4 here to let the jaws clear
demo._carry_src: demo carry peak 8.7 cm above grasp (p10 5.6, p90 12.9)
demo._release_src: demo releases ~0.5-0.7 cm above seating (order-0 release minus grasp 0.7 cm)

fallback_site._src: demo stacks 100% at world (0.000,-0.201). NOT a task requirement (native reward is pairwise stacking only); used only if no observed block can serve as an IK-feasible base. The point lies inside the config ProhibitedArea, so layouts should keep it clear; checked against observed blocks anyway.

grasp._tilts_note: 0 = demo top-down. Tilted approaches (pitched away from the arm base about the closing axis) extend reach: it1 dev02 had a block at ~0.52 m from both bases, beyond the demo's max top-down grasp distance (0.49 m).
grasp._carry_note: 0.087 = demo carry peak above grasp; 0.05 lower option for reach
grasp._open_note: pre-shaped jaw gap = block side + 3 cm (it1 dev01: full 8.8 cm opening shoved the neighbouring base block)
